flows.title: Create a LinkedIn Page
steps: Click the For Business icon in the upper-right corner of your LinkedIn homepage.
Scroll down and click Create a Company Page.
Select the Page type: Company, Showcase page, or Educational institution.
Enter your Page identity, Company or Institution details, and Profile details information.
Select the verification box to confirm that you have the right to act on behalf of the company or school.
Click Start building your page! to complete your LinkedIn Page.

flows.title: Add an admin to your Page
steps: Go to your Page super admin view.
Click Settings in the left menu and select Manage admins.

Click the Page admins tab to give someone a role on the Page itself, or the Paid media admins tab to give them an advertising role. Only one Page admin role can be assigned per person, while more than one paid media admin role can be.
Enter the name of the member, associated employee, or advertiser you would like to add in the Search for a member field.
Select the admin's name from the list that appears.
